visualCharacteristics: Full-width promo rows, each pairing a photograph beside a text block (heading + paragraph + solid primary button). Rows alternate image-left / image-right down the list; stacks image-on-top on mobile.
contentPattern: One row per promo; each row has an image cell and a body cell (heading + paragraph + button link).
usage: Service/program promos on section landing pages (e.g. patient-care, member-eligibility).
